primary: AB/BA blocks only; A minus B; negative latency delta favors A (assigned-room-batch)
control: Middle AA pair reported separately, never pooled into AB inference
uncertainty: 10000 deterministic hierarchical paired bootstrap draws: resample four AB/BA pairs, then matched wave indices within each pair; retain all four participants in each sampled wave
interval: Percentile 2.5/97.5; descriptive and limited by four pairs on one shared host
exclusions: Only the predeclared one-wave warmup per condition per block is excluded from primary timing; all raw observations and failures retained. No load-based exclusions or outlier trimming.
limits: No production SLO or equivalence threshold is asserted; intervals cannot prove absence of a small regression.
